name: Multi-dimensional Profiles
definition: Weighted averages or distributions of a variable with respect to one, two, or three independent variables. Implemented as BinnedProfile1D, BinnedProfile2D, or BinnedProfile3D classes.
summary: Multi-dimensional Profiles compute weighted averages of dependent variables across up to three independent axes, distinguishing themselves from standard histograms by analyzing physical properties like mass rather than voxel counts.
